text:
emma: Quick check — onboarding `cerebro-13b-qs` into staging. I pushed weights to gs://rw-weights/cerebro/13b/quantized/v2 (sha: e7a1f4). Anyone seen tokenizer quirks when moving from hf-tokenizer?
emma: Also want to validate serving config before enabling canary. Thinking: continuous batching on, min_batch=2, max_latency_ms=40, max_tokens_per_request=2048. Thoughts?
nikhil: confirmed weights location, I can wire the modelstore entry. tokenizers: there's a leftover special token <|image_token|> that HF doesn't map by default. we should add it to the vocab map.
sam: +1 on adding special token mapping. Also watch for tokenization truncation: HF default truncation side is 'right' but our eval prompts expect 'left' for some instruction prompts.
sam: For batching knobs, 40ms might be tight for 13B on g5. I'd suggest start with max_latency_ms=75 and min_batch=4 for staging load tests.
maria: FYI I ran fast validation on a sample of 250 prompts. Found 0.7% of outputs contained split token artifacts — likely the special token. Attaching small diff in PR.
emma: thanks. Can you paste the staging config snippet you used?
maria: sure:
```yaml
model: cerebro-13b-qs
weights: gs://rw-weights/cerebro/13b/quantized/v2
tokenizer_overrides:
  add_special_tokens: ["<|image_token|>"]
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  min_batch_size: 4
  max_wait_ms: 75
  max_tokens_per_request: 2048
caching:
  kv_cache_ttl_secs: 600
  prefix_cache_enabled: true
scheduler:
  policy: latency_aware
  priority_buckets: [realtime, standard, bulk]
```
nikhil: That looks good. Two suggestions: set `kv_cache_ttl_secs` to 900 for prompt-similarity workloads and enable `batch_padding_threshold: 0.25` to avoid extreme padding waste.
emma: what does batch_padding_threshold do?
sam: batch_padding_threshold is the max fraction of padding tokens allowed in a batch before we split it. 0.25 is sensible. If you have many long/short mixes, it prevents a huge pad cost.
qa-bot: load-test report (staging): 1k concurrent users, p95 latency 220ms with min_batch=2,max_wait_ms=40 — staging infra overloaded. With min_batch=4,max_wait_ms=75 p95 ~140ms and throughput improved.
emma: ok that's convincing. Plan: update tokenizer mapping, set min_batch=4,max_wait_ms=75,batch_padding_threshold=0.25,kv_cache_ttl_secs=900,enable prefix cache.
emma: who wants to own the PR and config validation? cc @nikhil @maria
nikhil: I'll open PR for modelstore + runtime config. Will include unit test for tokenizer mapping and a small smoke test for KV cache TTL.
maria: I'll add the tokenizer integration test and re-run the 250-sample validation.
sam: I'll schedule a short canary window tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT and monitor traces. If p95 <200ms and no token artifacts, we promote.
infra-bot: deploy plan queued: canary slot created on staging cluster-7, reserve 2 nodes. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
emma: thanks all. Quick reminder — add `max_total_tokens=4096` check in config validator to avoid OOM on very long system + user prompts.
nikhil: good call, will add a lint rule in the onboarding script to validate `max_tokens_per_request + max_prompt_tokens <= max_total_tokens`.
qa-bot: noted — will run regression after PR merge.
emma: perfect. tagging this thread resolved for now, will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
